content.title: Hand-Drawn Live-Action Fusion Generator
content.summary: Bring rough, luminous hand-drawn entities into contact with live-action space through continuous deformation while the camera follows half a beat behind. The Seedance companion preserves that physical mechanism while requiring original settings and transformation chains.

quick_start.input_format: Live-action setting + hand-drawn entity + physical contact trigger + continuous deformation chain + slightly delayed camera follow + original ending
quick_start.recommended_input: Bring a rough, luminous hand-drawn entity into contact with real space, sustain one continuous deformation chain, and let the camera track half a beat behind; the Seedance companion preserves the deep mechanism while requiring a new setting and transformation path.
required_anchors: Use the pinned official MiniMax H3 upstream Skill.
Use the independent Seedance 2.0 companion for Seedance.
Do not copy the upstream Skill body or duplicate it into ComfyUI.
usage_steps: Choose the matching official MiniMax H3 Skill and install it from the pinned upstream link.
Prepare only the assets and facts required by that Skill.
Use the independent Seedance companion when targeting Seedance 2.0.
Validate identity, timing, text and asset responsibilities before generation.
applicable_scope: Bring a rough, luminous hand-drawn entity into contact with real space, sustain one continuous deformation chain, and let the camera track half a beat behind; the Seedance companion preserves the deep mechanism while requiring a new setting and transformation path.
Projects that match the upstream Skill's declared purpose and asset contract.
not_suitable_for: Tasks outside the upstream Skill's declared scope.
Cases that require copying the upstream Skill body into this library or importing it into the T8 ComfyUI node.

creative_dna.usage_scope: Bring a rough, luminous hand-drawn entity into contact with real space, sustain one continuous deformation chain, and let the camera track half a beat behind; the Seedance companion preserves the deep mechanism while requiring a new setting and transformation path.
creative_dna.source_boundary: MiniMax H3 uses the pinned official upstream Skill. Seedance 2.0 uses the independently authored companion Skill in this library. The upstream Skill body is not copied.
creative_dna.comfyui_boundary: This official entry is not imported into ComfyUI because the target node already includes the official MiniMax capability.
